```{r, include=FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratWrappers)
library(tidyverse)
library(Biobase)
library(BiocGenerics)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)
library(harmony)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
rm(KPC_combined, all_genes_KPC_tumours)
```

# Integrate data

## Merge

```{r, include=FALSE}
DefaultAssay(LLC_tumour) <- "RNA"
DefaultAssay(B16_tumour) <- "RNA"
DefaultAssay(MC38_tumour) <- "RNA"
DefaultAssay(KPC_tumour) <- "RNA"

LLC_tumour$experiment <- "LLC_tumour"
B16_tumour$experiment <- "B16_tumour"
MC38_tumour$experiment <- "MC38_tumour"
KPC_tumour$experiment <- "KPC_tumour"

tumours_combined <- merge(LLC_tumour, y = list(B16_tumour, MC38_tumour, KPC_tumour), add.cell.ids = c("LLC_tumour", "B16_tumour", "MC38_tumour", "KPC_tumour"))
```


## Pre-process


```{r, include=FALSE}
tumours_combined <- NormalizeData(tumours_combined) %>%
  FindVariableFeatures() %>%
  ScaleData() %>%
  RunPCA(npcs = 50)
```

```{r}
ElbowPlot(tumours_combined, ndims = 50)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
tumours_combined <- tumours_combined %>%
  FindNeighbors(dims = 1:39) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.9)

Idents(tumours_combined) <- "seurat_clusters"

umap.method = 'umap-learn'
metric = 'correlation'

tumours_combined <- RunUMAP(tumours_combined, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:39)
```


## Visualize data sets prior to Harmony Integration

```{r}
DimPlot(tumours_combined, reduction = "umap", group.by = "experiment", repel = TRUE, pt.size = 1) +
  ggplot2::labs(title = "", x = "UMAP1", y = "UMAP2") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank())
```


## Run harmony

```{r, include=FALSE}
tumours_combined <- RunHarmony(tumours_combined, group.by.vars = "experiment")

tumours_combined <- FindNeighbors(tumours_combined,reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:39) %>% 
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.9)

tumours_combined <- RunUMAP(tumours_combined, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:39)
```


## Visualize data integration after harmony

```{r}
DimPlot(tumours_combined, reduction = "harmony", group.by = "experiment", repel = TRUE, pt.size = 1) +
  ggplot2::labs(title = "", x = "HARMONY1", y = "HARMONY2") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank())
```

```{r}
DimPlot(tumours_combined, reduction = "umap", group.by = "experiment", repel = TRUE, pt.size = 1) +
  ggplot2::labs(title = "", x = "UMAP1", y = "UMAP2") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank())
```



# Annotate clusters 

```{r, include=FALSE}
DefaultAssay(tumours_combined) <- "RNA"

Idents(tumours_combined) <- tumours_combined$seurat_clusters
tumours_combined <- JoinLayers(tumours_combined, what = "all")
```


## Specify clusters

```{r, include=FALSE}
tumours_combined_cluster_ids <- levels(tumours_combined$seurat_clusters)

tumours_combined_cluster_labels <- c("Malignant cells", "Monocytes/macrophages", "Monocytes/macrophages", "Malignant cells", "Malignant cells", "Epithelial cells", "Malignant cells", "NK cells", "Malignant cells", "Epithelial cells", "Monocytes/macrophages", "Endothelial cells", "Endothelial cells", "Malignant cells", "NK cells", "NK cells", "T cells", "Cancer-associated fibroblasts", "Malignant cells", "Monocytes/macrophages", "Malignant cells", "NK cells", "Endothelial cells", "Neutrophils", "Monocytes/macrophages", "B cells")

tumours_combined_clusters <- tumours_combined@meta.data$seurat_clusters

tumours_combined$seurat_clusters <- tumours_combined_cluster_labels[tumours_combined$seurat_clusters]
```


## Order clusters

```{r, include=FALSE}
tumours_combined$seurat_clusters <- factor(tumours_combined$seurat_clusters, levels = c("Malignant cells", "Endothelial cells", "Cancer-associated fibroblasts", "Monocytes/macrophages", "Neutrophils", "B cells", "T cells", "NK cells", "Epithelial cells"))
```


## Set cluster colours

```{r, include=FALSE}
cluster_colours <- c(
    "Malignant cells"                = "#8A8A8A",
    "Endothelial cells"              = "#D2B48C",
    "Cancer-associated fibroblasts"  = "#7CFC00",
    "Monocytes/macrophages"          = "#99CBFF",
    "Neutrophils"                    = "#4169E1",
    "B cells"                        = "#C9A2FF",
    "T cells"                        = "#B44CFF",
    "NK cells"                       = "#5B0E8A"
)
```


## Dotplot showing highly expressed genes between clusters

```{r}
DefaultAssay(tumours_combined) <- "RNA"
Idents(tumours_combined) <- "seurat_clusters"

DotPlot(object = tumours_combined, features = c(
  "Myc", "Igfbp4", "Rhox5", "Nedd4", # Malignant cells
  "Cdh5", "Pecam1", "Igfbp3", "Igfbp7", # Endothelial cells
  "Col1a1", "Col1a2", "Serping1", "Dcn", "Fn1", "Mmp13", "Timp1", # Cancer-associated fibroblasts
  "Ptprc", # General immune cells
  "Cd209a", "Itgam", "Ccr2", "Fabp5", "Ly6c1", "Ly6c2", # Monocytes
  "Cd68", "Cd74", "Cd83", "Ccl6", "Ccl9", "C1qa", # Macrophages
  "S100a8", "S100a9", "Retnlg", "Ifitm1", # Neutrophils
  "Cd79a", # B cells
  "Il7r", "Cd4", # T cells
  "Nkg7", "Klra7", # NK cells
  "Epcam", "Krt15" # Epithelial cells
)) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1, face = "italic")) +
  scale_color_gradientn(colors = c("red", "white", "blue")) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, face = "italic"))
```


## Remove Epithelial cells

```{r, include=FALSE}
epithelial_cells_removed <- "Epithelial cells"

tumours_combined <- subset(tumours_combined, seurat_clusters != epithelial_cells_removed)
```


## Visualize clusters

```{r}
DimPlot(tumours_combined, reduction = "umap", group.by = "seurat_clusters", repel = TRUE, pt.size = 1, cols = cluster_colours) +
  ggplot2::labs(title = "", x = "UMAP1", y = "UMAP2") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank())
```



# Clean up tumour_combined seurat object

```{r, include=FALSE}
cols_to_remove <- c(
  "RNA_snn_res.1.2",
  "sample_name",
  "Immune_Subclusters",
  "integrated_snn_res.0.5",
  "RNA_snn_res.0.9",
  "RNA_snn_res.0.5",
  "scDblFinder.class"
)

for (col in cols_to_remove) {
  tumours_combined[[col]] <- NULL
}

tumours_combined@meta.data <- tumours_combined@meta.data[, c(
  "experiment",
  "orig.ident",
  "seurat_clusters",
  "nCount_RNA",
  "nFeature_RNA",
  "percent.mito"
)]
```


## Change idents of B16F10, KPC, and MC38 tumours

```{r, include=FALSE}
tumours_combined$orig.ident[tumours_combined$orig.ident %in% "B16F10_tumours"] <- "B16F10 tumours"

tumours_combined$orig.ident[tumours_combined$orig.ident %in% c("GC117164", "GC117165", "GC117166")] <- "MC38 tumours"

tumours_combined$orig.ident[tumours_combined$orig.ident %in% c("GC117164", "GC117165", "GC117166")] <- "MC38 tumours"
```


## Remove unused objects

```{r, include=FALSE}
rm(B16_tumour, KPC_tumour, LLC_tumour, MC38_tumour, col, cols_to_remove, epithelial_cells_removed, metric, tumours_combined_cluster_ids, tumours_combined_cluster_labels, tumours_combined_clusters, umap.method)
```
